## Design

### 2026-10-08 – October 8 2026, I started by wondering what micro controller i would use for this build due to the fact that my completed project required a graphical os and other features such as wireless connectivi

**4h**

October 8 2026, I started by wondering what micro controller i would use for this build due to the fact that my completed project required a graphical os and other features such as wireless connectivity. I stumbled upon Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-C6 A very small and compact microcontroller with dual CPU and 512 kb of sram and most importantly very competent Wi-Fi and Bluetooth.
Ithen sketched how I would like the inputs to be on the smart watch (sketch in the repo) I than listed the inputs and outputs required for this to work. I spent the rest of my time looking for videos to educate myself on how to build a pcb and the pins on the microcontroller. tomorow I will be designing the pcb using kicad.
